title: Audience‑mapped launch summaries and stakeholder review playbook
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a repeatable playbook and canonical templates for drafting tiered launch summaries, internal briefing notes, and customer-facing changelogs. Playbook must include audience mapping (developers, platform admins, executives), content redaction rules for legal/privacy, signoff matrix, and a lightweight process for last-minute patches to release notes (security or breaking changes). The deliverable is a one-page playbook, a pair of templates (internal brief / public changelog), and a short training run with 3 stakeholders to validate the flow.
acceptance_criteria: One-page playbook reviewed and approved by PM, Design, and Legal
Internal brief template (doc link) with fields for impact, mitigations, rollbacks, and owner
Customer-facing changelog template with tiered sections (what changed, migration notes, compatibility, customer actions)
Signoff matrix populated with owners and SLA for reviews (24h standard for non-security changes)
Training run and stakeholder feedback captured and >=80% positive on clarity
tasks: Collect redaction guidance from Legal & Security
Design templates in Console doc format (Design review)
Run 1-hour tabletop with Eng/Support/Sales to exercise playbook
Publish playbook in internal Confluence and add to release checklist

decisions: Use a two-track changelog: 'Developer detail' and 'Customer digest' to avoid information overload
Signoff SLA: 24h for PM/Design/Eng, 6h for Security/Legal on security-sensitive items
Include an 'Impact score' (0-5) and 'Migration required' boolean in templates
risk: Medium — coordination latency between Legal and Engineering can delay publication. Risk mitigation: pre-approved redaction rules and an emergency 'security patch' release path with abbreviated signoff.
owner_notes: Aim to reduce release-note turnaround by 40% for minor releases. If Legal review repeatedly blocks, propose quarterly redaction blocklist signoff.
qa_checks: Templates render correctly in Confluence and Drive
Fields auto-populate for PR links and release tags where available
Redaction examples are present and verified by Legal
rollback_plan: If a published changelog contains sensitive info, immediate steps: 1) pull public page, 2) notify customers via email with corrected note, 3) create incident ticket and post-mortem. Owner: Head of Product Communications
notes: Prefer short bullet summaries for customer-facing sections; link to deeper developer docs
Consider adding a machine-readable changelog JSON for the Console to ingest in future releases
